In the checkpoint lookup the point D1, D2 + 16 px, rounded down to 8 px, is kept in ram_FFCF9E, ram_FFCFA0 and searched in the lists at ram_cp_lists: the first (8-byte records, by halving) holds lines of one y, hit when the point's 32 px y band is that y and x lies strictly between the ends; the second (8-byte records from the offset in the header's first word, by halving) lines of one x, hit the same way across.\nThe third list (10-byte records from the offset in the header's second word, ram_cp_count less that offset / 8 of them) holds the other lines, scanned along x and hit when y lies between the ends and the point passes a 10 px closeness test against the line.
